name: One Family One Job Scheme
benefit: 1. Candidates registered under this scheme are eligible for all benefits provided by the Employment Department.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be between 18 and 35 years old (with a relaxation of up to 5 years for SC or BC applicants).
   1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana State.
   1. No member of the applicant&#39;s family should be employed in the public or private sector.
   1. No member of the applicant&#39;s family should be an income tax or sales taxpayer.
   1. No member of the applicant&#39;s family should be a current or former MP/MLA or a chairman of any board, corporation, or undertaking.
